title: The neural correlates of consciousness are the brain modulating the field

statements.text: The structural, functional and organizational characteristics of the neural correlates of consciousness indicate the brain’s interaction with and modulation of the ubiquitous field of consciousness. A coherently oscillating neural cell assembly acquires its phenomenal properties by tapping into the pool of phenomenal nuances in the field. The authors cite large-scale neural synchronization as evidence.
